description: The most recent Monero blocks with the observed block interval. When to use: checking that XMR is producing blocks normally and at roughly the 120s target. Do not use: for one specific block (xmr_get_block). Returns: tip_height, avg_block_interval_s, target_interval_s, blocks[] {height, hash, timestamp, tx_count, reward_xmr, difficulty, weight}.
name: xmr_get_recent_blocks
